title: Tesla Shows a Sports Car That Can Lift Into the Air
summary:
Can a car fly? On Thursday night, Tesla and its CEO, Elon Musk, showed off the new Roadster 2 at an event in McGregor, Texas. The event was at a rocket testing site run by SpaceX, another company Musk leads.

During the show, the car rose into the air with a jerky puff of steam. At one point, it seemed to float several feet above a Tesla truck. Tesla says four thrusters, powered by gas stored in the car, make this possible.

Tesla said the car could go from 0 to 60 miles per hour in one second. Musk said, "This is not necessarily a safety-optimized car."

Tesla says it will start making the Roadster 2 in 2028. The car was first announced in 2017 and was supposed to come out in 2020. Tesla did not say how much it will cost. There will be three versions, and only one is meant to lift into the air.
why_it_matters: It shows how engineers try wild new ideas, but safety still matters for anything people ride in.
